purpose: Defines the Repository's primary vertical navigation from Source toward Ground while preserving the graph, the 33-level framework and the Potatoism interpretive coordinates as independent systems.
principle: The Repository tree answers where a record is best encountered at a useful scale. It does not rank truth, importance, value or power. Domain, time, epistemic status and graph relationships remain independent dimensions.

secondary_coordinates.spirit_door_matter: Interpretive temporal/relational coordinate: Spirit = future/possibility, Door = present/transition, Matter = manifestation/trace. It is not the primary filing system.
secondary_coordinates.33_level_axis: Project-defined vertical framework retained as a deeper navigational and interpretive coordinate.
secondary_coordinates.domain: Religion, mythology, geography, politics, economy, science, technology, culture, security and other domains can occur at every scale.
secondary_coordinates.time: Past, present and future can occur at every scale.
secondary_coordinates.epistemic_status: Observable world, historical/textual record, project theory/research model and Potatoism/mythic canon remain explicitly separated.
secondary_coordinates.graph: Relationships may connect any records across any scale. The graph is not subordinate to the tree.

scale_layers.label: SOURCE
scale_layers.meaning: Origin, premise, source or highest-order orientation.

scale_layers.label: PRINCIPLES
scale_layers.meaning: Rules, values, laws, worldviews and organizing principles.

scale_layers.label: CONCEPTS & PATTERNS
scale_layers.meaning: Concepts, symbols, theories, models and recurring patterns.

scale_layers.label: WORLDS & DOMAINS
scale_layers.meaning: Broad environments, fields, civilizations and domains of activity.

scale_layers.label: INSTITUTIONS & STRUCTURES
scale_layers.meaning: Durable organizations, authorities, infrastructures and coordinating structures.

scale_layers.label: NETWORKS & GROUPS
scale_layers.meaning: Connected populations, communities, markets, alliances and movements.

scale_layers.label: PEOPLE & LIVING ACTORS
scale_layers.meaning: Persons, populations and other living participants.

scale_layers.label: EVENTS & ACTIONS
scale_layers.meaning: Things that happen, change, move or are done.

scale_layers.label: RECORDS & SIGNALS
scale_layers.meaning: Texts, measurements, documents, datasets and other observable traces.

scale_layers.label: GROUND / GRAIN / DUST
scale_layers.meaning: Smallest concrete trace or material unit relevant to the investigation.

placement_rule: Give each record one primary scale home where it is most useful to read it. Use cross-links and graph edges rather than duplicating the record at every scale it touches.
canonical_overrides: Use data/repository-scale.json for explicit record-level placements; do not let broad keyword classification override a canonical placement.
non_goals: Do not delete or flatten the existing 33-level framework.
Do not treat scale as a hierarchy of value or reality.
Do not erase Spirit/Door/Matter; retain them as a secondary Potatoism coordinate.
Do not flatten the graph into a tree.
Do not create duplicate records solely to satisfy navigation.
